nodes.label: Track
nodes.rationale: A single audio file (mp3, flac, wav, ogg, m4a, aac) on disk that derpy can play. Avoid: Song, file.

nodes.label: Earmark
nodes.rationale: A user-flagged Track that 'hit right' in the moment. Expires after 30 days. Encrypted, uploaded to Blossom, and recorded in a private Nostr list that follows the user's identity across devices. Avoid: Favourite, bookmark, like.

nodes.label: Tag (derpy)
nodes.rationale: A free-form, lowercase, user-authored string label attached to a Track for search/filter. Permanent (no expiry). Stored in a derpy-local index keyed by the Track's Sum, never written into the audio file itself. Avoid: Label, keyword, genre.

nodes.label: Sum
nodes.rationale: The metadata-invariant fingerprint of a Track's audio data, computed via dhowden/tag's Sum function (SHA-1 of audio bytes, skipping ID3/MP4/FLAC metadata blocks per-format). Used as the primary key for the Tag index. Survives renames and embedded-metadata edits, but not re-encoding. Avoid: Hash, fingerprint, checksum.

nodes.label: Sum cache
nodes.rationale: The mtime+size-validated path->Sum mapping at ~/.config/derpy/sum-cache.json. Bridges the file-system view (paths) and the Tag index (Sums). Populated lazily by the background indexer.

nodes.label: Tag index
nodes.rationale: The Sum->[Tag,...] mapping at ~/.config/derpy/tags.json. Source of truth for what Tags a Track has.

nodes.label: Nostr Integration (earmark + post)
nodes.rationale: Pressing [E] earmarks a track to a private NIP-51 list (kind 30001, NIP-44 encrypted). Pressing [P] publishes a public kind-1 Nostr note. The user's Nostr private key is persisted in ~/.config/derpy/config.json (0600 permissions).

nodes.label: Blossom Audio Upload
nodes.rationale: Upload local audio files to Blossom servers in encrypted 16 MB chunks (AES-256-GCM) so earmarked tracks can be played on any device. Uses BUD-01/BUD-02 blob storage, BUD-11 auth, kind-10063 server discovery. Required because public Blossom servers enforce a ~20 MB upload limit and typical FLAC files are 40-100 MB.

nodes.label: ListenBrainz Scrobbling
nodes.rationale: Optional scrobbling via LISTENBRAINZ_TOKEN env var or derpy token command. 'Playing now' is submitted immediately; scrobble fires at 25% completion (minimum 30s tracks).

nodes.label: Keyword Filtering
nodes.rationale: AND/OR/parentheses expression syntax for filtering playback (e.g. 'derpy jazz AND piano').

nodes.label: MPRIS2 D-Bus Service
nodes.rationale: MPRIS2 D-Bus service on Linux for playerctl/Waybar integration.

nodes.label: Offline Earmark Queue
nodes.rationale: Earmarks are written to ~/.config/derpy/queue.json immediately on [E] press and synced to Nostr on next startup when connectivity is available.

nodes.label: Duplicate Earmark Detection
nodes.rationale: Earmarks are keyed by file path; re-earmarking the same file is a no-op with an 'already earmarked' status message.

nodes.label: Track Deletion ([D] key)
nodes.rationale: [D] key deletes the current track from disk and advances to the next.

nodes.label: Default Source Directory
nodes.rationale: Saved via 'derpy --set-default-source <dir>' so user doesn't have to type the source directory every time.

nodes.label: NIP-44 Encryption
nodes.rationale: Earmarks use NIP-44 encryption so relays see only ciphertext; only the key holder can read the earmark list. Part of the privacy-first design.

nodes.label: 30-Day Earmark Expiry
nodes.rationale: Earmarks expire after 30 days — intentional design to capture what's resonating right now rather than building a permanent archive. Forces continued discovery.

nodes.label: External Tag Index (ADR-0001)
nodes.rationale: Tags live in two derpy-owned JSON files under ~/.config/derpy/: tags.json (Sum->[Tag,...]) and sum-cache.json (path->Sum with mtime+size validation). Keyed by dhowden/tag's Sum fingerprint (SHA-1 of audio data, skipping metadata blocks). This survives renames and embedded-metadata edits but not re-encoding.

nodes.label: tag.Sum Audio Fingerprint
nodes.rationale: SHA-1 of audio data alone, with embedded metadata (ID3v2, ID3v1, MP4 atoms, FLAC blocks) explicitly skipped per-format. Survives renames, moves, and metadata edits but not re-encoding.

nodes.label: In-File Metadata Alternative (rejected)
nodes.rationale: Writing tags into ID3v2/Vorbis Comments was rejected because it forces format-specific writer dependencies, restricts to MP3+FLAC, introduces write-during-playback complication, and risks corrupting source files. The interoperability gain isn't a requirement.

nodes.label: Chromaprint/AcoustID Alternative (rejected)
nodes.rationale: Requires external fpcalc binary and adds significant complexity. The re-encoding case isn't a real user need for V1.

nodes.label: AudioPlayer (audio.go)
nodes.rationale: Beep-based decoding/playback, pause/resume, position tracking via CompletionStreamer. Uses custom speaker.go instead of gopxl/beep/speaker.

nodes.label: Speaker (speaker.go)
nodes.rationale: Custom PulseAudio speaker backed by jfreymuth/pulse (pure Go, no ALSA headers). Exposes speakerInit/Play/Clear/Lock/Unlock.

nodes.label: ListenBrainz (listenbrainz.go)
nodes.rationale: Submits 'playing now' immediately, scrobbles at 25% completion (min 30s tracks).

nodes.label: Shuffle (shuffle.go)
nodes.rationale: Fisher-Yates shuffle seeded with current time.

nodes.label: Tags (tags.go)
nodes.rationale: Tag index (~/.config/derpy/tags.json) + NormalizeTags + filterPlaylistByTags (--tags CLI pre-filter).

nodes.label: SumCache (sumcache.go)
nodes.rationale: Sum cache (~/.config/derpy/sum-cache.json): mtime+size-validated path->tag.Sum mapping. Bridge between file-system paths and the Tag index.

nodes.label: Indexer (indexer.go)
nodes.rationale: Background SumCache indexer. Walks the source dir at TUI startup, hashes any uncached audio files, reports progress via indexProgressMsg. Playback is never blocked.

nodes.label: Model (model.go)
nodes.rationale: Bubble Tea model — keyboard input, progress bar rendering, note-saving to ~/track-notes.md.

nodes.label: Entry Point (main.go)
nodes.rationale: CLI args, recursive directory scan, playlist init, TUI/non-TUI dispatch.

nodes.label: dhowden/tag
nodes.rationale: Metadata + audio fingerprint via tag.Sum. Used for Tag index keying.

nodes.label: jfreymuth/pulse
nodes.rationale: Pure Go PulseAudio client — no ALSA headers required.

nodes.label: 100ms TUI Tick Interval
nodes.rationale: Progress updates at 100ms tick interval. Position calculated from elapsed wall-clock time with pause offset.

nodes.label: Tag Column (TUI)
nodes.rationale: Right-edge Tag column appears when current Track has Tags and terminal width >= 60.

nodes.label: Keyboard Controls
nodes.rationale: Left/Right: prev/next track, SPACE: pause/resume, E: earmark, P: post, T: tag, D: delete, ESC/q: quit.

nodes.label: Development Directives
nodes.rationale: Mandates: Go + Cobra CLI, Bubble Tea TUI, SOLID principles, well-commented code, tests in CI/CD pipeline, mark features complete in tech-spec.md.

nodes.label: SOLID Principles
nodes.rationale: SOLID principles required in software development for this project.

nodes.label: goreleaser Multi-Platform Build
nodes.rationale: Builds derpy for linux/darwin/windows on amd64/arm64 with CGO_ENABLED=0. Archives: tar.gz (linux/darwin), zip (windows).

nodes.label: Homebrew Formula (punkscience/homebrew-derpy)
nodes.rationale: Auto-updates formula on release via TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN.

nodes.label: nfpm .deb Package
nodes.rationale: Builds .deb packages for amd64 and arm64 via nfpm. Vendor: Punk Science Studios Inc.

nodes.label: Release Workflow (goreleaser)
nodes.rationale: Triggered on v* tag pushes. Runs goreleaser release --clean, conditionally includes Homebrew formula update via TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN.

nodes.label: APT Repository Workflow
nodes.rationale: Triggered on release published or workflow_dispatch. Downloads .deb artifacts, generates Packages/Release files, GPG-signs with APT_SIGNING_KEY, pushes to gh-pages branch for GitHub Pages APT hosting.

nodes.label: Chocolatey Publish Workflow
nodes.rationale: Triggered on release published or workflow_dispatch. Downloads checksums, updates nuspec version and install script URLs/checksums, packs and pushes to Chocolatey Community Repository.

nodes.label: Smoke Tests Workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs on release published. Three independent platform jobs: Linux (apt install in Docker), macOS (brew install), Windows (direct download). Each verifies derpy version matches the release tag.

nodes.label: Triage Labels System
nodes.rationale: Five canonical labels: needs-triage, needs-info, ready-for-agent, ready-for-human, wontfix.

nodes.label: GitHub Issues Tracker
nodes.rationale: Issues live in GitHub Issues on punkscience/derpy via the gh CLI.

nodes.label: Domain Docs Consumption Pattern
nodes.rationale: Before exploring, read CONTEXT.md and docs/adr/. Use glossary vocabulary. Flag ADR conflicts explicitly. Created lazily by /grill-with-docs.

nodes.label: Unlicense
nodes.rationale: Public domain dedication. Free to copy, modify, publish, use, compile, sell, or distribute for any purpose.

nodes.label: derpy (terminal music player)
nodes.rationale: Terminal music player with opinion: shuffle everything, earmark what's hitting right, let the list expire. Minimal TUI, Nostr integration, Blossom uploads, cross-platform.

nodes.label: derpy Icon
nodes.rationale: SVG icon: dark rounded rectangle (#1a1a1a) with green (#00ff00) monospace text '>_♪' conveying terminal/shell + music theme.

nodes.label: tech-spec.md Feature Tracking
nodes.rationale: Rules mandate referring to tech-spec.md to know next tasks and marking features complete when finished.

nodes.label: Blossom Server Management
nodes.rationale: derpy encrypts audio (AES-256-GCM) and uploads to Blossom servers in 16 MB chunks. Default servers: blossom.band, cdn.satellite.earth, nostr.build. Kind-10063 auto-discovery supported.

nodes.label: Nostr Key Setup
nodes.rationale: Requires Nostr private key (nsec1... or raw hex). Earmarks are NIP-44 encrypted. Key stored via 'derpy nostr-key' or prompted inline on first use.

nodes.label: Relay Management
nodes.rationale: Defaults: relay.damus.io, nos.lol, relay.primal.net, nostr.wine. Commands: list, add, remove, reset.

nodes.label: APT Installation (Debian/Ubuntu)
nodes.rationale: GPG-signed APT repository hosted on GitHub Pages at punkscience.github.io/derpy/apt/. Supports amd64 and arm64.

nodes.label: Homebrew Installation (macOS)
nodes.rationale: brew install punkscience/homebrew-derpy/derpy. Supports Intel and Apple Silicon.

nodes.label: Chocolatey Installation (Windows)
nodes.rationale: choco install derpy (submitted, pending moderation).

nodes.label: AudioPlayer (GEMINI.md ref)
nodes.rationale: Same AudioPlayer architecture description as CLAUDE.md — high-level abstraction managing beep streamers and scrobble tracking.

nodes.label: Speaker (GEMINI.md ref)
nodes.rationale: Same speaker description as CLAUDE.md — wraps beep/speaker, uses speakerLock/speakerUnlock.

nodes.label: Config (config.go)
nodes.rationale: Configuration persistence stored in ~/.config/derpy/config.json. Not referenced in CLAUDE.md architecture table.

nodes.label: Track Notes [n] (GEMINI.md)
nodes.rationale: Pressing 'n' appends current track to ~/track-notes.md.

nodes.label: Audio Safety (speakerLock/Unlock)
nodes.rationale: Use speakerLock() and speakerUnlock() when modifying audio state that the speaker might be reading.

nodes.label: Earmark Auto-Purge
nodes.rationale: Earmarks older than 30 days are automatically purged on startup, along with their uploaded audio chunks. Enforces the 'let the list expire' philosophy.

nodes.label: AES-256-GCM Chunk Encryption
nodes.rationale: Audio files encrypted with AES-256-GCM before Blossom upload in 16 MB chunks. Key stored in encrypted NIP-51 earmark payload.

nodes.label: Chocolatey Verification Procedure
nodes.rationale: Package downloads binary from official GitHub Releases at install time. SHA256 checksum in chocolateyInstall.ps1 generated automatically from release's checksums.txt by chocolatey-publish.yml workflow.

nodes.label: derpy earmarks command
nodes.rationale: Fetches the private Nostr earmark list and plays all earmarked files as a playlist (files missing from disk are skipped with a warning).

nodes.label: Public Nostr Post ([P] key)
nodes.rationale: Searches Bandcamp and YouTube for links, publishes a public kind-1 Nostr note: '[npub] is really digging [title] by [artist] right now! #music #derpy'.
